hold_text: Touches .github/workflows/pr-landing-hold-merge-alarm.yml (concurrency, PR selection, and a new pull-requests: write permission for the dedupe label). The manager merges.
why: ACTIONS-QUEUE-BACKLOG alarm dedupe (owner AM-OPS-7). Design approved by the manager 2026-11-19: 6h window, per-PR dedupe marker, single concurrency group without cancel. Tests required: a dropped push's PR is still graded by the next run, and a second grade does not page twice. Before: concurrency group per sha, so one queued run per push to main, each grading only its own push's PRs. After: one group (cancel-in-progress false). Each run lists recently closed PRs once and grades every PR merged in the last 6h that is in the alarm's scope (declaration missing or unreadable, or tier 2/3 + landing hold; every other declaration grades CLEAN locally with no API read) and does not carry the hold-merge-graded label. It labels each PR it grades to a final state (clean or alarm); UNREADABLE stays unlabelled for a retry. A failed listing exits 1 (could not look, never clean). Policy (grade) unchanged; self-test unchanged and passing. tests/test_pr_landing_hold_alarm.py 29 passed (5 new: dropped-push PR graded by the next run; a marked PR is not graded or paged again; window/scope/missing-declaration selection; CLI TSV and a non-list refusal; workflow wiring). No trader file touched (decide: SKIP). Revert: git revert. Gates this adds or changes: none (a detector, not a gate; same alarm policy).
